highlights: Own, monitor, and optimize Databricks and PySpark pipelines feeding daily KPI reporting layers.
Cut nightly load runtime by about 50% (7:30 AM to 3:00 AM) via re-partitioning and query tuning.
Built Python ingestion from rental, ERP, and OLTP sources into an AWS S3 data lake.
Near-real-time telematics pipelines using AWS Kinesis and Databricks Streaming.
Cut daily batch runtimes by 25-30% via partition tuning and incremental loads in PySpark and Databricks.
Built high-throughput Azure Databricks pipelines, reducing batch transformation runtimes by 25-30% through unified PySpark transformations.
Built Python, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy ingestion frameworks for enterprise ERP payloads into Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
Built dbt Core models (staging, intermediate, and marts layers) for KYC risk scoring and loan ledger reconciliations, with schema and custom SQL tests and incremental loads.
Cut runtime on large-scale financial pipelines by about 30-35% via Spark UI analysis, data salting, Adaptive Query Execution, and broadcast joins.
Built AWS Glue and PySpark pipelines processing sales, subscription, and revenue data for Redshift and Athena analytics.
Extracted enterprise SQL Server legacy data into S3 data lakes using Apache Sqoop on AWS EMR.
